Print configured PAT entries and their validation state

Usage: coop github status [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --vm <NAME>  Also show this VM's assigned entry and effective selection source
      --probe      Resolve each entry's `cmd:` invocation (may trigger Keychain / 1Password prompts) to confirm the secret store still serves it
      --json       Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the text report
  -h, --help       Print help
